Both input images are strict CANONICAL appearance and rendering references. Reproduce THIS EXACT character and softly shaded pixel-art style, not a redesign: golden-blonde voluminous shoulder-length curls with cowlick, bright blue eyes, thick BLACK RECTANGULAR glasses (NOT round), adult chibi woman, navy blue hoodie with pocket and drawstrings, loose charcoal trousers, black boots. Her hair shape, skin tone, eye style, hoodie shade and head-to-body ratio must match the reference. Crisp small square pixel clusters, restrained palette, gently shaded retro game sprite, not smooth vector, not high-detail illustration. Frame 2 leans in so book conceals the bottom of her face, eyes peeking over pages in concentration. Frame 3 eyes brighten, one index finger lands on a particular page, tiny golden discovery sparkle above the page, SAME book. Frame 4 turns SAME open book toward viewer and proudly points at the found passage, friendly knowing smile. Page marks are abstract strokes only, no text. No bag, receipt, keys or extra objects.
